header.title: PulseScale
header.description: A constant beat to draw attention to a CTA. `variant` picks the pattern, `trigger` when it runs and `scale` how much it grows at the peak (when omitted, `intensity` sets it). `ping` adds an expanding ring. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the content stays still.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. `scale` set to `auto` lets `intensity` define the peak; `ring` set to `auto` only shows it with `ping`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `heartbeat` is a double beat (the default), `breathe` a smooth wave, `pop` a short bump with a long rest (for badges and chips) and `ping` grows and emits a ring.

badge.title: Notification badge
badge.description: A slow `pop` with `ring` and the ring color in `--gemfx-pulse-scale-ring-color`. The ring takes the root's `border-radius`, so round it like the content.

triggers.title: Hover and click
triggers.description: With `trigger="hover"` it beats while the pointer (or focus) is over it. With `click`, each click toggles it on or off. At rest, the content stays at its normal size.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is one full cycle in milliseconds, including the rest between beats.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: When `scale` is omitted, `intensity` sets the peak (`sm` 1.04, `md` 1.08, `lg` 1.14). It also sets how far the ring expands (`1.28`, `1.42`, `1.62`), even if you pass `scale`. It takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: `scale` sets the peak factor, between `1` and `2`. High values are very noticeable: keep them for small elements.

ring.title: Ring
ring.description: `ring` shows the ring with any variant; `ring={false}` removes it from `ping`. It's an `aria-hidden` `span` below the content.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without a wrapping `div`. Here, a gem-system `Button` with `variant="breathe"` and `trigger="hover"`: it stays still until you hover it or tab to it.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the current pose. `isDisabled` stops the beat and returns the content to its size, which stays interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onPulseScale` fires when the beat starts and `outPulseScale` when it stops, with the cause in `event.reason`. The motion doesn't block interaction: the button still gets clicks.

header.title: PulseScale API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `PulseScale`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each variant and trigger.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/pulse-scale` with its `pulse-scale.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> except scale, and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter and onPointerLeave run before the effect's internal logic.

items.hidden: The ring has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none. The beat is transform only: it doesn't shift layout and the child keeps receiving clicks and focus.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the content stays at its normal size and the ring doesn't show.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the animation. Only use it if the motion is essential.
items.autoplay: With trigger="always" the beat starts on its own and never ends. WCAG 2.2.2 requires a way to pause automatic motion that lasts more than five seconds: offer a control that sets isPaused, turn it off after a while with isActive, or use hover/click.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" it also beats on keyboard focus (:focus-visible on the root or inside), so it shows while tabbing. A mouse click that focuses a button doesn't keep it beating. onPulseScale only fires with the pointer.
items.click: With trigger="click", the toggle listens to the root's click. If the child is a button, it also responds to Enter and Space.
items.meaning: The beat draws attention but doesn't communicate anything: if it marks something new or pending, say it with text or an ARIA attribute too (like the aria-label on the example badge).

items.trigger: Active trigger (`always` adds no class). Keeps the surface still until hover/focus or click.
items.ringOn: Added when the ring is visible.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`; keeps the surface still.
items.disabled: Added with `isDisabled`. Removes the pointer cursor.
items.surface: Wraps the child and is what beats (`transform: scale`).
items.ring: Expanding ring, below the surface. Takes the root's `border-radius`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `duration`, `delay`, `scale` and `ring` are always written inline on the root: use the props to change them. `--gemfx-pulse-scale-ring-color` isn't written inline, so a class can override it.

items.duration: One full cycle. Set by `duration`; default `1400ms`.
items.delay: Delay before starting. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.scale: Peak factor. Set by `scale` or, if missing, `intensity`; default `1.08`.
items.ring: Final ring scale. Set by `intensity`; default `1.42`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables PulseScale reads as defaults.

items.easingExit: Curve of the ring as it expands.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content beats and where the effect is mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Cycle duration and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it beats and how it's paused or turned off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`. Every variant, trigger and state applies the same. With the ring visible and a void element (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the `div`, since the ring can't mount inside it.
items.scale: Peak factor, clamped to `1`–`2`. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `1.04`, `1.08` or `1.14`.
items.intensity: Sets the peak (if `scale` is missing) and the ring expansion. A token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.ring: Shows the expanding ring. By default it's only on `ping`.
items.duration: One full cycle. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.trigger: `always` always beats, `hover` while the pointer or focus is over it, `click` toggles with each click.
items.isActive: Allows the beat. With `false` it stops and `outPulseScale` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Stops the beat; the child stays interactive. `outPulseScale` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if the motion is essential.
items.onPulseScale: Fires when the beat starts: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter with `hover` or when toggled on with `click`.
items.outPulseScale: Fires when it stops: on pointer leave, when toggled off with `click`, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-pulse-scale-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
